title: 深层价值向量是否需要残差流的上下文？
summary: 研究发现，在Transformer深层，学习无上下文的价值向量（仅保留原始token信息）能提升模型性能。提出Bank of Values（BoV）方法，通过查找表为最后三分之一的层学习token特定价值向量，在135M和780M模型上优于标准注意力，且计算和内存需求更低。
summary_en: The study finds that learning context-free value vectors (preserving original token information) in deep transformer layers improves model performance. It proposes Bank of Values (BoV), which uses a lookup table for token-specific value vectors in the last third of layers, outperforming standard attention on 135M and 780M models with less compute and memory.
